name: Omega Whisper
description: An Exclusive Defense-type Bit Beast cloaked in crystalline void armor. Wields a dark sword to unleash Void Cataclysms while sheltering allies behind impenetrable Void Aegis and Obsidian Barriers.

skills.name: Void Aegis
skills.description: Omega Whisper reinforces its dark armor for 3 rounds, immediately gaining +25 Defense and absorbing incoming hits to build up to 3 stacks of Shadow Ward (+15 Defense per stack).

skills.name: Obsidian Barrier
skills.description: Deploys a crystalline void shield that reduces all incoming damage by 40% for the next 2 rounds and negates enemy critical hit bonus damage.

skills.name: Void Cataclysm
skills.description: Plunges its dark sword into the ground, unleashing a massive purple void shockwave that deals 222 damage, cancels all opponent attack buffs, and restores 450 HP.
